capabilities: Run real zsh/bash terminals in tabs, splits and windows
Review Claude Code edits as diffs with accept, reject and undo
Explain failed commands and suggest fixes via Claude
Track multiple Claude sessions with groups and an agent inbox
Let agents open terminals, message sessions and drive a local browser
extras: macOS/Linux only (Windows unsupported); needs Python 3.9+ and a logged-in Claude CLI; session logs, agent control and the agent browser are opt-in; session log prompts are written to disk (up to 2,000 characters each).
problem: Running Claude Code in a separate terminal leaves you hunting for what it changed, pasting errors into chat, and babysitting sessions with no visibility inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: You type claude (or anything else) exactly like you would in any other terminal, with nothing wrapped or intercepted

summary: PTY-backed terminal for Obsidian with Claude Code integration: failure explanations, per-file diff review with accept/reject, and multi-session agent management.
